environment: Ubuntu 24.04 virtual runner, Linux 6.17.0-1022-azure, Keepalived 1:2.2.8-1build2, IPVS 1:1.31-1ubuntu0.1
traffic: one sequential fresh-flow client per protocol, short echo payloads, requested 100 attempts/s, 250 ms timeout

each_protocol.fault: 29/42 passed; 13 failed after about 250 ms; 11.6 actual attempts/s

limit: One ~17-second virtual run. Sequential 250 ms timeouts reduced the offered rate during failure, so 13/42 is not a loss rate at 100 attempts/s. Keepalived process RSS snapshots double-count shared pages; process CPU ticks exclude kernel forwarding. No sustained throughput, host resource ceiling, independent clients, NIC behavior or production SLO was measured.
